items.title: All the credit cards can be divided into 4 categories for forex transactions. 💳🌍 1️⃣ Category-1: Best Ones 🏆 The credit cards which refund the entire forex mark-up charges along with the main amount in case of order cancellation + they do not charge any mark-up on the refund amount. 👉 HDFC Credit Cards are Category-1 cards. Use HDFC Bank’s Infinia or Diners Black Credit Card after activating the Global Value Program, and get 3.33% Rewards + 1% Cashback - 2.36% Forex Mark-up = 1.97% Net Valueback. And most importantly, no risk of losing money in case of a refund. ✅ 2️⃣ Category-2: Not-so-good ⚠️ Cards like HSBC credit cards which do not refund forex mark-up charges, but they also do not charge anything on the refund amount. So, not the best, but better than Axis Bank and ICICI Bank Credit Cards. 👉 Use HSBC Premier Card, if you have one, as it charges just 1.17% Forex Mark-up, so you lose relatively small amount in case of a refund. You get 4% rewards = 8.8% Accor Value and no forex mark-up charges. 💯. Wait for 15th August for upcoming Zero forex mark-up offer on HSBC Cards. 3️⃣ Category-3: Zero Forex Mark-up Cards 💳✈️ Cards like Scapia, RBL World Safari, AU ixigo, IDFC WOW Credit Card etc. do not charge any mark-up on forex transactions.
